label: neutral
summary: Default when no genre is chosen: classical continuity drama pacing.
source: Maestro guideline; not measured on a corpus.

rhythm.note: cut when the information of a shot is delivered; hold longer on emotion

camera: static by default; slow push-in for emphasis; tracking to follow movement
look: one motivated light source per scene, same direction in every shot; soft for tenderness, hard side or top light for threat
acting: natural, specific and motivated; play an objective, never a state
